name: Feet in Straps — Frog
summary: Feet in the long loops, heels together and knees open. Bend in to a diamond and press the legs out long on a diagonal.
steps: Lie on the back with the long loops over the feet, tailbone heavy.
Legs long on a 45° line, slightly turned out, heels touching.
Breathe in to bend the knees open over the hips.
Breathe out to press out along the same diagonal, squeezing the inner thighs.

layers.title: Heels apart
layers.text: Keep a small gap between the heels the whole time.

layers.title: Breaststroke legs
layers.text: Press out, open wide, circle back to the diamond.

layers.title: Open and bend
layers.text: From long legs, one leg opens straight to the side while the other bends to a frog; press both back together.

modifications: Lighter spring if the pelvis rocks.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.
Keep both legs moving together; skip the one-leg layer.

cues:
Heels stay glued together.
Knees stop above the hips — they don't fold into the chest.
Tailbone stays down; no arching as the legs go out.
Neck and shoulders relaxed.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
